symptom: describe page -> exec on a Studio Pro-built project dropped `AttributeRef: null` from the Forms$StaticOrDynamicString Address of every static OPEN_LINK button (Forms$OpenLinkClientAction), so an unchanged page was rewritten (ako/mxcli-ledger FINDINGS #170)
cause: staticAddressToGen never set AttributeRef and no type default emitted it; its comment conflated the stored AttributeRef key with gen's extra, never-stored `Attribute` key, so the omission looked deliberate
insight: Two near-identical key names, one stored and one invented by gen: the earlier 'never invent a key' reasoning was right about `Attribute` and wrongly extended to `AttributeRef`. A key-set sweep of the references (21 of 21 static addresses carry AttributeRef: null) settles it in seconds; a NullFields default is safe for the dynamic branch because it only fills an unset key. Grepped first that no other RegisterTypeDefaults existed for the type, since a second registration replaces the first (#812). The default is per $Type, so it also reaches a navigation menu item's address; the #980 test's hand-built menu fixture lacked the key and failed. `mx convert -p` (11.15.0) on a menu item written without it adds AttributeRef: null, so the fixture, not the writer, was wrong: when no stored reference exists for a context, convert is the measurement.
